summary: Armada is a Western Australian owned multidisciplinary group (tax, audit, bookkeeping, financial planning, lending) with offices in Osborne Park and Port Hedland and over 35 years of history. Neil Hancy joined in 2004, heads financial planning and joined the board as a director in 2023. He is a planning director rather than an accounting-operations owner, so the follow-ups ask to be pointed to whoever runs bookkeeping.

hooks.text: Two offices (Osborne Park, Port Hedland) with bookkeepers inside a multidisciplinary group; ask Neil who owns bookkeeping reconciliations.
Client praise for Neil's availability links to freeing hours from manual reconciling.

risks.text: Neil leads financial planning, not bookkeeping operations; he is probably not the buyer and may redirect.
Larger firm (about 59-77 staff) than the usual sweet spot, with separate audit, planning and lending arms.

gaps: No public posts, podcasts or interviews by Neil on reconciliation or technology.
No job ads or tech-stack evidence found for Armada's bookkeeping team.
No named head of bookkeeping found with a verified email.
